thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: metering-pulse anomaly detected (token_count drift > 18% vs 24h baseline) in prod-eu-west. auto-page to #incidents and oncall.

eve-oncall: saw it, picking up. oncall responding — pulling logs now :eyes:

alex-sre: quick snapshot: emitter->kafka lag spiked ~230k msgs around 01:12 UTC. Aggregator throughput dropped ~3x. suspect consumer restart/GC in eu workers.

maria-billing: CS pinged — 4 customers saw overage emails (small startups). need assessment before sending broader comms.

jessica-cs: forwarded two screenshots from customers, one shows consecutive identical counts for multiple minutes -> looks like duplicate replay or sticky counter.

alex-sre: logs (tail):
```
2026-03-18T01:11:58Z emitter[pid=82] INFO emit batch=512 offset=12345678
2026-03-18T01:12:03Z emitter ERROR kafka produce timeout
2026-03-18T01:12:04Z emitter WARN retrying batch=512 attempts=3
2026-03-18T01:12:07Z aggregator[pid=9] WARN consumer lag=231234
```

sean-eng: I'm seeing increased retry rates on replay logic in front of the emitter. I can push a temporary flag to disable replay dedupe to stop amplification.

ryan-platform: recommend switching traffic to backup emitter in us-central for EU customers temporarily (routing policy) while we mitigate. will run canary failover.

eve-oncall: action list:
- @alex-sre restart emitter pods in eu-west (rolling) and monitor kafka lag
- @sean-eng toggle replay flag to reduce duplication
- @ryan-platform failover route for customer traffic to backup emitter
- @maria-billing prepare targeted customer note if we confirm billing noise

alex-sre: running:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/metering-emitter-eu-west
# monitoring: kpow tail aggregator | grep lag
```

sean-eng: flipping flag now: POST https://flags.internal/api/set { "metering.disable_replay": "true" }

ryan-platform: failover started — routing policy updated (policy-id: route-2026-03-18-01). starting a 10m canary to verify token parity.

eve-oncall: update: kafka lag down to 18k after restart, emitter error rate falling. replay flag off reduced duplicate writes per metrics.

maria-billing: CS hold — will delay wide customer notice. drafting targeted messages to the 4 affected customers with reconciliations + estimated backfill window.

jessica-cs: adding samples to ticket #SUP-1129 so billing team can run quick recon.

alex-sre: next steps: run recon job (reconcile-token-counts) scoped to affected accounts, schedule backfill job at 02:30 UTC, and prepare idempotent dedupe for replay path.

- recon & backfill: alex-sre
